files.description: The Contract Opportunites data is available as a daily electronic download in order to promote data sharing and provide a way for related government systems to download data reliably and efficiently. This folder includes all public Contract Opportunity data collated nightly as a snapshop in time with an updated date as the timestamp.

files.name: ContractOpportunitiesFullCSV.csv
files.description: Contract Opportunities is a government-wide list of notices of proposed contract actions expected to exceed $25,000. Notices include solicitations, pre-solicitations, sole source justifications, awards and other notices related to the acquisition of supplies and services. Select any domain level folder to see folders and specific data files which can be downloaded.
